name: Invoice & Receipt Reader → Google Sheets (Harborline demo)

parameters.content:
## AI invoice & receipt reader → Google Sheets
**Live demo:** https://n8n.rixgpt.com/webhook/invoices

1. Upload a PDF/photo (or pick one of 3 sample PDFs the workflow generates itself).
2. **Gemini** reads it with no template: supplier, dates, PO, line items, subtotal, tax, total, category.
3. Checks: required fields, line items = subtotal, subtotal + tax = total, duplicate supplier + invoice number, due date.
4. Status: clean and under 500 → Auto-approved; 500+ → Waiting for approval; any failed check → Needs review.
5. A row goes to **Google Sheets** (Invoices tab); approve / send back updates the status cell.
6. Owner register lists everything from the last 7 days.

Files are not stored; successful executions are not saved (privacy). Daily cap 60.
Built by Aqib ur Rehman. Harborline and the suppliers are fictional.
### 1 · Upload page and reading an invoice (Gemini → checks → Google Sheets)
### 2 · Result page and one-click approval (updates the status cell in Sheets)
### 3 · Sample PDFs (made by the workflow) · owner register
